SELECT * FROM tobj WHERE objct = 'Z_I87_NOPE' — a 10-character, well-formed but nonexistent object name — returns HTTP 200 with totalRows 0. This is the corrected retry of an earlier attempt that used the 14-character literal 'Z_I87_NO_SUCH_OBJ', which was too long for TOBJ-OBJCT's C(10,0) column and failed with HTTP 400 ''Z_I87_NO_SUCH_OBJ' is not a valid value for C(10,0)' — that failed attempt was never saved as its own raw capture, so only this corrected retry is reproducible here. A caller-supplied object name longer than 10 characters must be rejected client-side before it reaches this endpoint; the endpoint itself turns that into a hard 400, not an empty result.
